about: Every stored customer-concentration link that carries a disclosed share in data/edge_review_decisions.json on 2026-10-10: the 166 approved links (119 of them with two or more percentages in the sentence) and the 16 rejected ones, each sentence read by hand. label = the share the sentence gives THAT customer for the current year; null = no share can be attributed to it (a joint, aggregate or range figure, a prior-year-only table cell, a name collision, a percentage that is not a revenue share); "unconfirmed" = the stored excerpt starts mid-sentence. kind: ok | floor ("more than 10%") | wrong_value (the stored share belongs to another customer or year) | joint | aggregate | range | prior_year | collision | not_a_share | not_a_customer | unconfirmed. stored is what was published, status the stored review status. Sentences are from SEC 10-K and 20-F filings; the universe lists the tracked companies the reader can find in them. The labels were also the rules' tuning set, so the reader's score on them is a ceiling.
